evals.prompt: /adhd-decide I keep going back and forth between two laptops. One is cheaper, the other has a better screen. I've been researching for two weeks and I can't pick.
evals.expected_output: Restates the decision in one sentence, classifies it as reversible but meaningful, separates facts from interpretations, offers at most three options, gives one 5-20 minute next step and one decision rule with a date. Does not re-ask what was already said and does not invent prices or specs.

evals.prompt: /adhd-decide it's 11pm and I can't stop thinking about whether to launch my side project this week or keep polishing it.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the late hour and looping as a source of urgency, recommends pausing a non-urgent decision, gives a short grounding step and a time-boxed revisit, no shaming, no more than three options.
